newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CRA Managed Care cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CRA Managed Care cut.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it downgraded CRA Managed Care Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- Analyst Todd Richter said downgrade followed CRA Managed Care's announced merger with OccuSystems Inc.

-- Richter called deal "terrific, actually brilliant, strategically" but said the merger's financial structure was "a little confusing" which could cloud near-term trading outlook for stock because of extensive arbitrage.
-- "Any time there's a merger like this, arbitrage activity is going to take over for an extended period of time," Richter said. "The place to be right now analytically is neutral."
